title: Japan 20-Year JGB auction (November) — the second observation on whether the tapered bucket damages auction demand
source: EST: mof.go.jp English November 2026 auction calendar (policy/jgbs/auction/calendar/2611e.htm), fetched direct 2026-09-09 (HTTP 200, 25,188 bytes) by the jgb-20y-auction-2026-10-20 initial research; its table row reads 'Nov. 18, 2026 | 20-year'. No size is asserted: no November row carries an announcement href on 2026-09-09 and MOF's own note on the page reads 'Each issue amount will be announced about one week prior to each auction date', putting terms around 2026-11-11. The 20-year has run monthly at ¥700bn since 2026-04-14 per MOF's Auction Results for JGBs workbook (parsed 2026-09-09), so ¥700bn is the base case, not a claim. Filed `estimate` on the two counts every JGB entry on this calendar records: the size is anticipated rather than announced, and market-events-data.ts's confirmed-prefix taxonomy has no slot for a non-US sovereign debt office. Checked 2026-09-09
notes: Discovered during the jgb-20y-auction-2026-10-20 initial-research adjacency sweep (2026-09-09) on MOF's own November calendar, fetched while checking whether the 10-20 auction's terms had published. It earns a slot on one term: it is the second observation on the question the 10-20 ledger opened and could only answer with one auction. That ledger tested the 30-year lane's prediction that the BoJ's -55% taper of the 'more than 10 and up to 25 years' bucket should damage 20-year auction demand first, and found a null with the sign reversed — month-matched difference-in-differences against the 30-year, tail gap +0.45bp -> +0.04bp, DiD -0.41bp at t = -0.77, against a test that can only detect about 1.5bp. A second post-10-20 print is exactly what that power limit needs. On MOF's documented three-auction issue rhythm (new issues in Jan, Apr, Jul and Oct since at least 2024) 2026-11-18 should be the FIRST reopening of the issue sold on 2026-10-20, which also makes it the control leg for that ledger's finding that the new-issue-versus-reopening tail split is a pre-2015 regime artifact (full history +0.32bp, t = +2.24; 2015 onward -0.12bp, t = -0.66). It lands D+19 from the 10-20 auction and D+19 from boj-decision-2026-10-30, already tracked. NO PRICE CHANNEL IS CLAIMED and impact is `low` on the evidence the 10-20 ledger measured at this exact tenor: no tracked symbol carries yen-rates exposure, and the JGB-auction-to-US-long-end association does not survive controlling for the same-date JGB move (partial corr +0.027, t = +0.45, n=275) and leaves nothing at D+1. Estimate widens caution only; it licenses no date-keyed action.
